Retest data

RETEST_data.Rd

This dataset contains the simulated data of retest trials. The rows represents the 30 individuals when we are dealing with the balanced cases. The columns represent the evaluation points.

Usage

RETEST_data

Format

Matrix with 30 rows and 100 columns

Examples

RETEST_data
